title: Hoeffding finite-sample lower bound

paper.title: Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables

hypothesis: A bounded independent-trial concentration inequality can expose how little precision a small success count supports.
causalBoundary: Only matured Bernoulli outcomes enter the count; dependence and effective sample size remain explicit unmet assumptions.
counterfactual: At fixed successes and confidence, increasing the valid trial count should narrow the concentration penalty.
